title: Computational biology assisted exploration of phytochemicals derived natural inhibitors to block BZLF1 gene activation of Epstein-Bar virus in host.
authors: Naveed, Muhammad; Hussain, Muzamal; Aziz, Tariq; Hanif, Nimra; Kanwal, Nazia; Arshad, Arooj; Khan, Ayaz Ali; Alshammari, Abdulrahman; Alharbi, Metab
one_liner_zh: 该文用AlphaFold、分子对接和MD模拟筛选植物天然产物抑制EB病毒BZLF1编码的Zta蛋白，属于蛋白-小分子药物筛选，而非TF-DNA互作建模，但结构预测与对接方法可迁移至蛋白-DNA体系，故给5分。
abstract: The Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) is widespread and has been related to a variety of malignancies as well as infectious mononucleosis. Despite the lack of a vaccination, antiviral medications offer some therapy alternatives. The EBV BZLF1 gene significantly impacts viral replication and infection severity. The current study performed computer-assisted techniques to analyses the potential drug candidates against Epstein-Barr virus toxin Zta [Human gamma-herpesvirus 4 (Epstein-Barr virus)] from phytochemicals derived natural inhibitors. Various bioinformatics methods were employed to predict and analyze the toxin protein structure obtained from NCBI, and its secondary and tertiary structures were predicted using PSIPRED and the AlphaFold. ProtParam was used to assess physiochemical characteristics. Natural inhibitors were found in the literature and PubChem, tested with PyRx, and performed blind docking by using CB-Dock, then the top selected drug candidate from natural inhibitors was analyzed for possible drug development applications using preADMET, Molinspiration, and MD simulations. Density functional Theory analysis was executed to predict the transition energies and the reactivity. Imperatorin was the best candidate for developing the drug against toxin protein Zta coded by the BZLF1 gene because it exhibited the lowest binding energy (- 6.3 kcal/mol) during natural inhibitor screening. Imperatorin's compliance with Lipinski's Rule of 5 and favorable pharmacokinetics make it an ideal therapeutic agent against EBV. Since vaccines and medications are crucial for treating infectious diseases and cancer, computational approaches seem promising and less costly to design and discover potential drug candidates and vaccines with the help of in silico methods but further in vitro research is required for experimental validation.
abstract_zh: EB病毒（Epstein-Barr virus, EBV）广泛传播，并与多种恶性肿瘤及传染性单核细胞增多症相关。尽管缺乏疫苗，抗病毒药物仍提供了一些治疗选择。EBV的BZLF1基因显著影响病毒复制和感染严重程度。本研究采用计算机辅助技术，从植物化学来源的天然抑制剂中分析针对EB病毒毒素Zta [人γ-疱疹病毒4型（EB病毒）]的潜在药物候选物。运用多种生物信息学方法预测和分析从NCBI获取的毒素蛋白结构，并使用PSIPRED和AlphaFold预测其二级和三级结构。利用ProtParam评估理化特性。从文献和PubChem中筛选天然抑制剂，使用PyRx进行测试，并通过CB-Dock进行盲对接，随后对从天然抑制剂中选出的最优药物候选物，使用preADMET、Molinspiration和MD模拟分析其潜在的药物开发应用。执行密度泛函理论分析以预测跃迁能和反应性。Imperatorin是针对由BZLF1基因编码的毒素蛋白Zta开发药物的最佳候选物，因为在天然抑制剂筛选中其表现出最低的结合能（-6.3 kcal/mol）。Imperatorin符合Lipinski五规则并具有有利的药代动力学特性，使其成为针对EBV的理想治疗剂。由于疫苗和药物对于治疗传染病和癌症至关重要，计算方法在借助计算机模拟手段设计和发现潜在药物候选物及疫苗方面显得前景广阔且成本较低，但仍需进一步的体外研究以进行实验验证。
